node.title: RS flat-nullity basis charge
node.statement: After factoring the global roots of a rank-a RS kernel slice, write u=k-a-|G| and v=|G|-|P_0|. Every proper rank-j flat of each nonloop zero-set matroid has size at most j+u, so ordered basis extension gives a*b_e>=m_e*C(m_e-u-1,a-1). Summing against the post-strip pencil cap and combining with the persistent-root subset-packing bound leaves only 14/8, 70/49, and 323/274 possible (u,v) pairs at RowC selector rank five for P-A/P-B, from 32131, 7875, and 1891 pairs respectively. This is a structural residual reduction, not a new rank payment.
